key_idea: Recasting the geometric tiling condition as a system of equations over finite groups to enforce an aperiodic number-theoretic sequence, which is then stacked into a single three-dimensional tile.
reason: The core strategy of translating geometric tiling into discrete algebraic equations to embed an aperiodic sequence is a highly elegant conceptual leap. However, executing this construction requires dense bookkeeping and intricate technical lemma chains, which significantly reduces its structural simplicity.
